description:
Leave one harness owner of the cascade wiring by removing the cascade re-proof from the lifecycle timestamp tests.

## Background

Harness-level tests at `crates/jit/src/commands/bulk_update.rs:2001` and `crates/jit/tests/fast_issue/lifecycle_timestamps_tests.rs:89` both drive the command cascade to dependents. A pure domain function owns the cascade's rules, and the `bulk_update.rs` test is the harness owner of its wiring.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `lifecycle_timestamps_tests.rs` asserts no cascade rule; a test there keeps the timestamp properties it asserts.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `bulk_update.rs` test remains the one harness test that asserts the cascade's wiring.
title: Lifecycle harness tests stop re-proving the auto-transition cascade
